title: Apparently the Orbital Strike Cannon works on PaperMC 26.1+ now
description:
This is a video where I just wanted to leave some record of this contraption working in Paper now.
This has been working on Paper since February 15 and yet there has been no noise or mention of it whatsoever, so I think it is a good thing to at least leave some sort of evidence.

If you need to ask some additional questions, feel free to join my discord:
discord.biquaternions.me

You can enable this and other redstone contraptions back by following Paper's official guide to restore vanilla-like behavior:
docs.papermc.io/paper/vanilla/

These options are not the default on Paper for a reason, as some reintroduce attack vectors or exploits that malicious users can exploit in public servers.
However, from their guide you actually only need to change 3 of those configuration options to make the Orbital Strike Cannon work in 26.1.2:

1. In paper-global.yml you only need to enable tnt duping
unsupported-settings.allow-piston-duplication: true

2. In spigot.yml you need remove the tnt limit (-1), or set it to any high value:
max-tnt-per-tick: -1

3. In paper-world-defaults.yml you need to set chunk upload delay to 0s to be able to use the remote firing via the fishing rod:
chunks.delay-chunks-unloads-by: 0s

4. For slower systems, the cannon will freeze the server for a lot of time. If the server freezes for too long, it stops automatically and cause the payload to explode too high in the sky. To prevent this, in spigot.yml, increase the time the server can remain frozen (600 is 10 minutes, you can increase it even more if you need to):
settings.timeout-time: 600


FAQ:
1. Does this work in 1.21.11?
Actually yes, but only after 1.21.11 build 116, be sure to update your Paper server to the latest build. Although I do recommend to always try to stick close to their latest stable version, 26.1.2 at the moment of writing this.
You can find all the builds for 1.21.11 in their build explorer:
fill-ui.papermc.io/projects/paper/version/1.21.11

2. Does this work in 1.21.10, 1.21.9, 1.21.8...?
No, this only works in 1.21.11 onward.
This is due to a bugfix that was reported and fixed in 1.21.11 build 116, Paper does not backport changes to older versions so it will only be available in the latest builds of 1.21.11 and all the build of 26.1.2, 26.2 and so on.
Issue report in Moonrise:
github.com/Tuinity/Moonrise/issues/162
Fix in Paper:
github.com/PaperMC/Paper/commit/1f1406f1b68fd7413d3c29ca85b4b487b6aeb5dc

3. Does this work on Purpur, Folia...?
No idea, every Paper fork makes their own changes to the software, be minimal or large, it can change how the game behaves.
I can only guarantee this works on Paper.
If you're interested in looking if this contraption works in any particular software you use, give it a try, I have another video setting up the schematics and importing the build into a local server.
Here's the server used in the video in case you want to try it quick:
www.mediafire.com/file/qfe1zem89p6xifu/osc.zip/file
